nodes.title: City blocks
nodes.content:
import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import box

# Four city blocks near the Chicago Loop, in EPSG:3395 (World Mercator, metres).
cx, cy = -9752000, 5137000
blocks = [box(cx + i * 400, cy, cx + i * 400 + 300, cy + 300) for i in range(4)]

return gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    {
        "land_use": ["residential", "commercial", "residential", "park"],
        "population": [1240, 310, 980, 0],
        "median_rent": [1650.0, 2100.0, 1480.0, 0.0],
    },
    geometry=blocks,
    crs="EPSG:3395",
)
nodes.goal: Return city blocks as a GeoDataFrame in EPSG:3395: land_use (object), population (int64), median_rent (float64), geometry (polygons, active).

nodes.title: Parks
nodes.content:
import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import box

# Two parks beside the blocks, in EPSG:3395 (World Mercator, metres).
cx, cy = -9752000, 5137000
parks = [box(cx, cy + 500, cx + 700, cy + 900), box(cx + 1000, cy + 500, cx + 1300, cy + 700)]

return gpd.GeoDataFrame(
    {"park_name": ["Grant", "Maggie Daley"], "area_m2": [280000.0, 60000.0]},
    geometry=parks,
    crs="EPSG:3395",
)
nodes.goal: Return parks as a GeoDataFrame in EPSG:3395: park_name (object), area_m2 (float64), geometry (polygons, active).
